acceptanceCriteria: One real Corvint change is completed through the docs/DOGFOOD.md daily path (complete report, dogfood-check PASS, sealed CEM on main), and a `corvint-dogfood` receipt (profile corvint-use-case-evidence/0) is retained for each of UC-TASK-ORIENTATION, UC-CHANGE-CONSEQUENCE and UC-EVIDENCE-CARRYING-COMPLETION, pinned to the bind commit whose CEM is sealed and to byte-identical copies of that change's daily-path artifacts.
The ledger validator accepts the receipts, the ledger rows record them, and the rows stay `experimental` with claim UNPROVEN until the `beamfall-dogfood` class (V1-0184) exists.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 for V1-0011 criterion 3 and decision 0373 item 16. No `corvint-dogfood` evidence class exists for any Core row, and `verified` needs all six classes. The receipt binds one real Corvint change completed through the docs/DOGFOOD.md daily path: its retained orientation (`prechange-query`), consequence (`prechange-impact`) and completion (`dogfood-report`) artifacts are copied under conformance/use-cases-v0/receipts/<useCaseId>/corvint-dogfood/ as receipt subjects next to the sealed CEM, so they stay distinct from hostile tests and sealed benchmarks. Beamfall dogfood is V1-0184 and stays owner-run.
title: conformance: retain a `corvint-dogfood` receipt for the three Core use cases from the daily path on Corvint
